_meta.description: Manually maintained guide content: the single source for both player guides' narrative text and curated tables. Update this file when game content changes; scripts/verify_guide.py checks it against the code.

getting_started.hogwarts_letter: When you first reach 120 max HP (after using a Life Crystal) or defeat an early boss, an owl immediately delivers a Hogwarts Acceptance Letter. This grants a free Oak Wand and a short starter path for the mod.
getting_started.enchanting_table: The Enchanting Table is the mod's core crafting station. Nearly every wand, armor piece, potion, accessory, and boss summon uses it. Craft it early at a Work Bench from wood, Fallen Stars, torches, and either amethyst or stone; dungeon books are no longer required.
getting_started.wizard_tower: A small Wizard Tower generates on the surface during world creation. It contains a chest with starter wizard loot: a wand, potions, Essence of Magic, Fallen Stars, and an Enchanting Table. Only one spawns per world.
getting_started.spell_damage: The mod adds a custom damage class: Spell Damage. All wands deal Spell Damage. Armor, accessories, and buffs that boost spell damage are clearly labeled. Spell Damage benefits from generic damage bonuses but has its own modifiers.
getting_started.forbidden_forest: A custom biome that replaces normal forest spawns with magical creatures. Spawn diversity increases as more wizard bosses are defeated. The biome has increased spawn rates and drops exclusive materials like Unicorn Blood.
getting_started.welcome: Wizarding World turns Terraria into a Harry Potter adventure. You start as a first-year with a single wand and follow a guided route through 12 boss fights, a Horcrux hunt and the Battle of Hogwarts to Lord Voldemort, then claim the Deathly Hallows in a short epilogue. Along the way the mod adds wands and spells, house armor, magical creatures, town NPCs from the books, potions, events and a three-zone Forbidden Forest.
getting_started.how_to_use: Chapters 1 and 2 are a walkthrough: what to do first and the order the bosses unlock in. The rest of the guide is reference you can dip into: every boss, wand, armor set, accessory, potion, mount, pet, enemy and system, with the numbers taken from the mod's source code.
install: Install tModLoader from Steam (it is a free DLC for Terraria) and the .NET 8 SDK.
Copy the WizardingWorld folder into Documents/My Games/Terraria/tModLoader/ModSources.
Start tModLoader and open Workshop > Develop Mods, then choose Build + Reload.
Enable Wizarding World in the Mods menu and create a new character and world.
getting_started.install_note: The mod is a release candidate and is not on the Steam Workshop yet, so for now it is built from source as above. Requires tModLoader 1.4.4 or later.
first_steps: Use a Life Crystal (120 max HP) or beat your first boss: an owl delivers your Hogwarts Letter and a free Oak Wand.

Craft an Enchanting Table at a Work Bench from 20 wood, 5 Fallen Stars, 2 Amethyst and 5 Torches (no amethyst? 25 Stone works too, with a little more wood, stars and torches). Almost every wand, potion, armor piece and boss summon is made there.
Look for the Wizard Tower on the surface; its chest holds starter wizard loot.
Build a house for Ollivander, the wandmaker, who moves in once you own a wand.
Collect Essence of Magic from magical creatures. It is the mod's universal crafting material.
Summon the Mountain Troll with a Smelly Sock (1 Silk + 1 Fallen Star) when you feel ready.
getting_started.helpers: Two items keep you on track: the Boss Compass shows which boss is next and what it needs, and the Wizard's Almanac summarizes your progress through the route. Check them whenever you are unsure where to go.
getting_started.settings_note: Change these under Settings > Mod Configuration > Wizarding World.

wands.intro: Wands are the mod's main weapons. All of them deal Spell Damage and cost mana, and each casts a signature spell. They are grouped below by when you can make them.

tier2.name: Tier 2 - Early Game (Pre-Skeletron)
rows: Anti-Boggart charm; use Patronus for Dementors

tier3.name: Tier 3 - Mid Game (Hardmode Entry)
rows: Repairs Protego shields, Room buffs, and wards

tier5.name: Tier 5 - Endgame (Post-Boss)
rows: Drops from Voldemort, scales with missing mana (+20%)
Upgrade of Phoenix Feather Wand, triple fire spread

wands.upgrade_note: * The Elder Wand drops from Voldemort. The Infernal Phoenix Wand is an upgrade of the Phoenix Feather Wand. The formerly separate Shadow Elder Wand and Wand of Destiny upgrade items have been retired into the Wand Mastery system. 'Wand of Destiny' persists only as Elder Wand mastery flavor.
wands.utility_note: Not in the tables: the Alohomora Key (shown in game as Alohomora Wand), a lockpick-style utility item that casts Alohomora and has no combat role.

bosses.intro: Twelve bosses span the whole game, from a troll in the dungeon to the Dark Lord. Each is summoned with its own item, made at the Enchanting Table, and can only be summoned once its requirement is met. Every boss has several phases and exclusive drops; Expert mode adds a treasure bag item.

list.name: Mountain Troll
list.phases: P1: Walks slowly, club swings, shockwave stomps. P2 (<50%): Enraged, faster, throws rocks.
list.drops: Troll Hide, Troll Club, Enchanted Troll Club
list.requirement: No requirement: summon it whenever you are ready.

list.name: Professor Quirrell
list.phases: P1 (Quirrell): Nervous, weak bolts. P2 (<60%, Voldemort reveals): Flies, green curses. P3 (<25%): Teleports, ring of projectiles.
list.expert: Quirrell's Turban (+5% spell dmg, detect creatures)
list.requirement: After the Mountain Troll and the Eye of Cthulhu.

list.name: Basilisk
list.phases: P1: Burrows underground, lunges. P2 (<50%): Fast charges + petrification gaze.
list.drops: Basilisk Fang, Sword of Gryffindor, Basilisk Eye
list.requirement: After Professor Quirrell and Skeletron. The last pre-Hardmode boss.

list.name: Aragog
list.phases: P1: Crawls toward player, spawns Acromantula minions. P2 (<40%): Web spit, faster, more spiders.

list.name: Fluffy
list.phases: P1: 3 cycling attacks (bite, pounce, bark shockwave). P2 (<50%): All heads attack, Jinxed on howl. P3 (<20%): Continuous charging + boulder barrage + pushback shockwaves. Music is its thematic weakness.

list.name: Hungarian Horntail
list.phases: P1: Flies, shoots fireballs. P2 (<55%): Enraged charges, tail swipe, fire breath. P3 (<25%): Rapid attacks, fire rain.

list.name: Dolores Umbridge
list.phases: P1: Hovers, Educational Decree (Jinxed). P2 (<50%): Petrified on contact, summons swords. P3 (<20%): Panic, rapid teleport.
list.requirement: After the Hungarian Horntail and a Mechanical Boss.

list.name: Fenrir Greyback
list.phases: P1: Fast charges, claw swipes, Bleeding. P2 (<50%): Full werewolf, howl spawns Werewolves. P3 (<20%): Berserk.
list.expert: Lycan's Bite Mark (+20% melee, +15% night speed)
list.requirement: After Dolores Umbridge, during a Blood Moon.

list.name: Bellatrix Lestrange
list.phases: P1: Hovers, Crucio/Stupefy, teleports. P2 (<60%): +Fiendfyre, faster teleport. P3 (<25%): Rapid-fire, 2 Death Eaters.
list.expert: Bellatrix's Wand Hand (+20% spell dmg, -15% mana cost)

list.name: Barty Crouch Jr
list.phases: P1 (Moody disguise): Walks, bolts, heals. P2 (<70%, true form): Flies, rapid dark curses. P3 (<30%): Teleports, Death Eater minions.

list.name: Dementor King
list.phases: P1: Hovers, dark energy waves, spawns Dementors. P2 (<60%): 'The Kiss' beam drains HP. P3 (<25%): 'Soul Harvest' dark vortex, pull effect. Patronus active = +30% dmg to this boss.
list.expert: Soul Siphon (3% life steal, enemies -5 def near you)
list.requirement: After Barty Crouch Jr and Golem, at night.

list.name: Lord Voldemort
list.phases: P1: Teleports, killing curses. P2 (<55%): Death Eater minions, rapid barrage. P3 (<20%): Desperate fury, Horcrux shields, 12-bolt ring AoE. Weakened by Horcrux Hunt (100% -> 40% power).
list.drops: Elder Wand (100%), Gaunt's Ring (100%), Soul Fragment (Expert)
list.expert: Soul Fragment (+20% all dmg, +100 mana, +5% life steal, -20% max HP)
list.requirement: After the Lunatic Cultist, at night.

After the Mountain Troll or the Basilisk, or 5+ town NPCs

After the Basilisk, or 6+ town NPCs
Free house-elf. Sells utility items and socks. Loyal helper.

Once St Mungo's is unlocked (after the Hungarian Horntail)
Offers restorative supplies and medical support tied to St Mungo's treatment and triage progression.

systems.name: Forbidden Forest Biome
systems.text: A custom biome that replaces normal forest spawns with magical creatures. Features increased spawn rates and drops Unicorn Blood as a rare exclusive. Spawn diversity increases as more wizard bosses are defeated.

systems.name: Death Eater Invasion
systems.text: Custom invasion event. Triggers randomly at night in Hardmode after defeating the Basilisk, or manually with a Dark Mark item. Spawns waves of Death Eaters, Dementors, and Inferi. Rewards Essence of Magic and rare drops.

systems.name: Quidditch Cup Season
systems.text: A school sports loop built around broom play, scoring, and the Golden Snitch. The Quidditch Cup is separate from the House Cup and House Renown progression. Snitch chases, Quidditch hoops, Madam Hooch support, and match rewards all feed this track.

systems.name: Triwizard Tournament
systems.text: A champion event centered on the Goblet of Fire. It runs as a Hogwarts, Durmstrang and Beauxbatons competition with champion selection, task progression, lake-rescue sequences, and tournament rewards.

systems.name: House Renown System
systems.text:
Earn renown for your Hogwarts house through combat. Points grant milestone buffs:
- 50 renown: Minor House Buff
- 150 renown: Major House Buff (5 minutes)
- 500 renown: House Champion (massive all-stat boost, resets renown)
Renown decays 1 per 10 seconds to encourage active play.
systems.canon_note: Canon-inspired: renamed from 'House Points' since canonical points are awarded by professors.

systems.name: Spell Combo System
systems.text:
Casting two specific spells in sequence on the same enemy triggers a bonus effect:
1. Stupefy + Incendio = 'Blazing Stun' (AoE fire explosion)
2. Expelliarmus + Sectumsempra = 'Disarming Slash' (massive crit)
3. Protego + any attack = 'Counter-Spell' (reflected damage doubled)
4. Impedimenta + Avada Kedavra = 'Execution' (instant kill non-boss <30% HP)
5. Stupefy + Riddikulus = 'Laughter Shield' (heal 50 HP)
6. Crucio + Fiendfyre = 'Hellfire Torment' (massive DoT stack)

systems.name: Daily Wizard Challenge
systems.text: A random daily task that rewards Essence of Magic. Changes every real-world day. Completing the challenge grants 15-30 Essence + a random buff. Check via Daily Prophet item or talking to Ollivander.

systems.name: Wizard Fishing
systems.text: Magical fish and wizard loot added to fishing catches. Scales with fishing power and biome.

systems.name: Wand Mastery System
systems.text:
Wands gain power through use rather than crafting upgrades:
- Level 0 (New): Base stats
- Level 1 (Familiar, 100 XP): -5% mana cost
- Level 2 (Attuned, 400 XP): -10% mana cost, +5% damage
- Level 3 (Mastered, 1000 XP): -15% mana cost, +10% damage, golden visual
XP gained: 1 per enemy hit. Persisted per wand in save data.
The old Shadow Elder Wand / Wand of Destiny upgrade path is retired. 'Wand of Destiny' survives only as Elder Wand mastery flavor text.
systems.canon_note: Canon-inspired: 'The wand chooses the wizard'  -- loyalty earned through use.

systems.name: Azkaban's Despair Event
systems.text: A late-game survival event themed around the wizard prison Azkaban. Triggered manually with an Azkaban Breach Stone after Golem. Floods the area with Dementors and Azkaban Guards. Patronus, the Warden's Key, and Ward of Hope consumables are the intended counter-mechanics. Light suppression and despair escalation make this a survival challenge rather than a generic wave event.
systems.canon_note: Canon-faithful: Dementors are Azkaban's guards, appearing during dark crises.

systems.name: Room of Requirement
systems.text:
A reusable key item that summons a magical room adapting to the player's needs. The room detects current state and grants a 3-minute buff:
- Recovery Room (HP < 50%): +12 life regen, +15 def, +10% DR
- Training Room (holding wand): +20% spell dmg, +10 spell crit, +40 max mana
- Vault Room (carrying 10+ gold): luck boost, treasure sense
- Sanctuary Room (default): balanced defensive buffs
In late progression it also serves as the Resistance HQ for D.A. / Hogwarts Resistance planning and Battle of Hogwarts staging. Crafted at the Enchanting Table. Cannot be used while any Room buff is active.
systems.canon_note: Canon-faithful: 'I need a place to...'  -- the Room appears when someone has great need.

systems.name: Diagon Alley and Gringotts
systems.text: The Leaky Cauldron acts as the hidden gateway into Diagon Alley. From there, Gringotts opens a cart descent into vault encounters, goblin services, and treasure-focused progression.

systems.name: Knockturn Alley
systems.text: A darker side street off Diagon Alley tied to Borgin and Burkes. Mr Borgin handles cursed trade, dark appraisals, and sinister utility items for players leaning into riskier wizard progression.

systems.name: Whomping Willow and Shrieking Shack Passage
systems.text: The Whomping Willow conceals the route to the Shrieking Shack. This secret passage loop emphasizes guarded transit, moonward preparation, and hidden approach rather than a tourist landmark.

systems.name: St Mungo's Triage
systems.text: A healing and recovery loop centered on St Mungo's and the Healer NPC. It focuses on treatment, triage, restorative support, and emergency stabilization rather than resurrection.

systems.name: Forbidden Forest Expeditions
systems.text: Forest progression extends through multiple expedition routes, culminating in the Thestral Clearing as the fourth expedition loop for late exploration.

systems.name: D.A. / Hogwarts Resistance
systems.text: Late-game resistance content built around Dumbledore's Army, the Hogwarts Resistance, castle-side preparation, and rallying defenders through Aberforth, Neville, and allied support loops.

systems.name: Battle of Hogwarts
systems.text: The final siege layer where Hogwarts Resistance systems, castle defenses, rally buffs, and endgame story progression converge before the Voldemort finale.

deathly_hallows.intro: The three Deathly Hallows form a hidden set bonus when all are equipped/held simultaneously.
artifacts: Elder Wand (weapon, held in inventory) - 150 base damage Avada Kedavra
Invisibility Cloak (accessory, equipped) - Invisibility, -400 aggro, +5% damage
Resurrection Stone (accessory, equipped) - +40 max HP, life regen
deathly_hallows.master_of_death: When all three are active, the hidden 'Master of Death' state is awakened as a world milestone. Effects are survival-oriented: debuff immunities, detection, reduced aggro, corruption cleansing, moderate stat boosts, and one fate-style death rescue per Terraria day.
acquisition: Elder Wand: 100% drop from Lord Voldemort
Invisibility Cloak: unique reward from Dumbledore after Azkaban's Despair + core Horcrux Hunt
Resurrection Stone: awakened from Gaunt's Ring by Dumbledore after Voldemort falls

endgame_goals: Destroy the core Horcruxes, reclaim the true cloak, and awaken the stone through Dumbledore

canon_disclosure.intro: The Wizarding World mod draws heavily from the Harry Potter series. Most content is faithful to the source material, but some mechanics are adapted or original for gameplay reasons.

categories.label: Canon-faithful
examples: Elder Wand as the single Deathly Hallow wand (not a separate Wand of Destiny item)
True Invisibility Cloak as a unique, non-craftable heirloom
Resurrection Stone tied to Gaunt's Ring
Riddikulus as the anti-Boggart charm (not anti-Dementor)
Patronus as the primary anti-Dementor defense
Dementors tied to Azkaban, dark events, and narrative context

categories.label: Canon-inspired adaptations
categories.description: Based on canon concepts but adapted for Terraria gameplay
examples: Wand Mastery system (loyalty through use, inspired by 'the wand chooses the wizard')
House Renown (combat-based; canonical House Points are professor-awarded)
Reparo repairs magical wards and buffs (canon repairs objects; adapted for gameplay utility)
Horcrux Hunt weakens Voldemort mechanically (narrative simplification of book 7)
Spell Combo system (original mechanic inspired by wizard dueling)

categories.label: Mod-original content
categories.description: Original gameplay content not from the source material
examples: Phantom Stag (Hallow biome enemy, not a real corrupted Patronus)
Room of Requirement as a buff-granting key item
Spell Damage as a custom tModLoader damage class
Infernal Phoenix Wand (upgrade of Phoenix Feather Wand)
